description: This file defines a mock class OcdmSessionMock for the IOcdmSession interface, used for unit testing DRM session handling in the Rialto server component. It includes mock methods for session management, license handling, decryption, and status retrieval.

classes.name: OcdmSessionMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IOcdmSession interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: constructSession
methods.description: Mocks the creation of a media key session with specified session type and init data.

methods.name: getChallengeData
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of challenge data for license acquisition.

methods.name: storeLicenseData
methods.description: Mocks storing license data received from license server.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Mocks updating the session with license response data.

methods.name: decryptBuffer
methods.description: Mocks decryption of an encrypted buffer.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Mocks decryption with additional parameters, marked for removal.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the status of a key.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Mocks selecting a key ID for the session.

methods.name: hasKeyId
methods.description: Mocks checking if a key ID exists.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the last DRM error code.
